rightsNote:
Everything in this knowledge base is written by icanspeak Spanish and generated from this site's own data. None of it is scanned, copied or taken in part from a coursebook — that is exactly why we can give it away. Every file says at the bottom where it comes from.

What is deliberately NOT here: audio and book files from publishers and exam bodies (coursebooks, DELE, SIELE or CCSE preparation books). We are not allowed to pass those on, not even for free and not even in class. Instead, we link to the official pages of the exam bodies and dictionaries — see “Official materials”. icanspeak Spanish is not affiliated with the Instituto Cervantes or the SIELE partners.

faq.q: Where can I download free Spanish grammar PDFs?
faq.a: Here: one grammar book per level from A1 to C1 and one complete book, each with rules, tables, exercises and answers. They are free, with no account and no email address, and you may print them and share them in class.

faq.q: Which PDF is right for my level?
faq.a: If you are not sure, start with Grammar Start (A1–B1): the ten chapters you need first. Or take the free placement test on this site, which tells you your level.

faq.q: Is there a free PDF of Spanish verb conjugations?
faq.a: Yes: the conjugation tables cover the most useful Spanish verbs in every tense and mood, and there are separate lists of irregular verbs, reflexive verbs and verbs with prepositions.

faq.q: Are the PDFs really free? Can teachers use them in class?
faq.a: Yes. We wrote everything ourselves from this course's own material, so we can give it away. You may print the files and share them with your students. You may not sell them or publish them on other websites.

faq.q: Where can I find official sample material for DELE, SIELE and CCSE?
faq.a: The Instituto Cervantes and SIELE publish their own material, and we do not copy it. We link to it under “Official materials”, where it is always up to date.

faq.q: Do the grammar books have answers?
faq.a: Yes. Every exercise has lines to write on, and the answers are in a key at the back of the book. Each chapter also links to the same topic online, where your answers are checked right away.
